question_vi: GitLab CI, Jenkins, CircleCI khác gì so với GitHub Actions?
question_en: How do GitLab CI, Jenkins, and CircleCI compare to GitHub Actions?
answer_vi: **GitHub Actions** (built-in GitHub, free cho public repo): YAML trong `.github/workflows/`, marketplace lớn nhất, ưu tiên cho dự án đã ở GitHub. **GitLab CI** (built-in GitLab): `.gitlab-ci.yml` ở root repo, runner self-host miễn phí, auto-DevOps stack đầy đủ — phù hợp self-hosted enterprise. **Jenkins** (self-hosted, open-source): pipeline-as-code dùng `Jenkinsfile` (Groovy DSL), plugin ecosystem khổng lồ nhưng phải tự maintain server + upgrade plugins, hợp công ty có sẵn ops team. **CircleCI** (cloud-first): docker-based executors, parallelism mạnh, free tier nhỏ — hợp startup chạy nhiều jobs song song. **Khi nào chọn cái nào**: project ở GitHub → Actions; ở GitLab → GitLab CI (tích hợp issue/CR); enterprise on-premise → Jenkins; cần fast parallel test cloud → CircleCI hoặc Buildkite. **Tiêu chí đánh giá**: pricing (per-minute vs per-user), runner location (cloud vs self-hosted), secret management, caching primitives, matrix builds, approval gates. Tránh lock-in: viết pipeline portable (shell scripts trong repo, gọi qua bất kỳ CI nào) — giúp migrate dễ dàng
answer_en: **GitHub Actions** (built into GitHub, free for public repos): YAML in `.github/workflows/`, largest marketplace, preferred when the project is already on GitHub. **GitLab CI** (built into GitLab): `.gitlab-ci.yml` at repo root, free self-hosted runners, full Auto DevOps stack — fits self-hosted enterprise. **Jenkins** (self-hosted, open source): pipeline-as-code via `Jenkinsfile` (Groovy DSL), huge plugin ecosystem but you must maintain the server and upgrade plugins yourself — suits companies with a dedicated ops team. **CircleCI** (cloud-first): docker-based executors, strong parallelism, small free tier — fits startups running many parallel jobs. **When to pick which**: project on GitHub → Actions; on GitLab → GitLab CI (tight issue/MR integration); on-prem enterprise → Jenkins; need fast parallel cloud tests → CircleCI or Buildkite. **Evaluation criteria**: pricing (per-minute vs per-user), runner location (cloud vs self-hosted), secret management, caching primitives, matrix builds, approval gates. To avoid lock-in: write portable pipelines (shell scripts in repo invoked from any CI) — makes migration easy
